name: Isomesh Octree Build and Clustering
aliases: Voxel Level of Detail with Dual Contouring
definition: A hierarchical mesh generation method using an octree structure over a uniform grid. It builds the octree recursively, then clusters vertices at each node level (leaves, edges, faces, cells) using Disjoint Set Union (DSU) and Quadratic Error Function (QEF) solvers to merge geometric primitives while preserving material properties and minimizing reconstruction error.
summary: Isomesh Octree Build and Clustering is a hierarchical mesh generation method that recursively clusters vertices using Disjoint Set Union and Quadratic Error Function solvers to ensure topological consistency across the hierarchy.
